name: 10992 · Washingtonvle, NY
findings: ZIP 10992 (Washingtonvle) has 24 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 10992 (Washingtonvle) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
